title: Ivy Lane uses block buildings insurance
detail: The structure is insured through the service charge. The separate Geo policy is leaseholder cover, not standalone buildings insurance.

title: Blackthorn needs separate buildings cover
detail: Each flat owner is responsible for arranging the building insurance for that property.

title: Do not chase Andrew or Carl
detail: Andrew Armitage and Carl Davies are parked until Ryan decides otherwise.

title: Inbox should stay deliberately quiet
detail: Routine and promotional email is marked read. Genuine decisions, deadlines and material risks remain unread and starred.

title: Use Ryan's financial-coach voice
detail: British English, conversational and practical. Avoid em dashes, stiff phrasing and generic marketing language.

title: Protect family time and flexibility
detail: Do not manufacture work simply to keep a project moving. Resume content when there is useful capacity.
